[SWS_CM_11042] DDS serialization of enumeration data types
⌈
Enumeration
data types shall be serialized according to the standard serialization rules for DDS
ENUM_TYPE defined in section 7.4.3.5 of [20].
The bit bound of the ENUM_TYPE shall be set to the size of the enumeration’s underlying
basic data type (i.e., the Primitive Cpp Implementation Data Type according
to [SWS_CM_00424]) in bits.
⌋
